num_nodes: <int> Total number of locations in the network, including the depot.
distance_limitation_d0: <int> Maximum total travel distance allowed for the round-trip route.
depot_vertex: <int> Index of the home depot location where the route must start and end.
coordinates: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nodes][2]> Two-dimensional position of each location, used to define the network geography.
scores: <list[int], length num_nodes> Reward collected by visiting each location, with the depot always having a score of zero.
distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nodes][num_nodes]> Symmetric matrix of rounded Euclidean travel distances between every pair of locations.
